content.short: Meso Finance is an open-source, non-custodial lending and borrowing protocol on Aptos.
content.description: Meso Finance is a decentralized money market built on the Aptos blockchain, providing users with a secure and efficient way to lend and borrow digital assets. The protocol focuses on capital efficiency and risk management, utilizing real-time price feeds from Pyth Network to ensure the safety of its liquidity pools. As a non-custodial platform, Meso Finance allows users to maintain full control of their assets while earning interest or accessing liquidity, contributing to a transparent and permissionless financial ecosystem on Aptos.
